# BrainSTEM to NWB mapping specification

<!-- Generated by `brainstem-nwb mapping` (scripts/generate_docs.py); do not edit by hand. -->

Mapping version **1.3.0**. BrainSTEM data model generation `specimen-1` (read from the server at run time), project export format 2.2.

Each row is one rule. *Sources* are BrainSTEM fields as `app.model.field` (model field names, as in the project export). Values are written as stored; units are converted only where the table says so. Nothing is written when a source is empty unless *When missing* says otherwise, and every gap is recorded in the conversion manifest with its state (`present`, `missing`, `unknown`, `not_applicable`, `not_exported`).

| `subject.genotype` | Subject.genotype | `stem.subject.genotype` | verbatim | — | always | not written |

## Intervals

| Rule | NWB destination | Sources | Transformation | Units | Condition | When missing |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `epochs.rows` | NWBFile.epochs | `stem.epoch.start`<br>`stem.epoch.end`<br>`stem.epoch.name`<br>`stem.epoch.behavior`<br>`stem.epoch.dataacquisitions`<br>`stem.epoch.manipulations` | one row per epoch, sorted by start, order and id: start_time and stop_time in seconds relative to the session start (BrainSTEM stores them as durations from the session start); tags = [name]; columns brainstem_id, behavior, data_acquisitions, manipulations (links to records of other subjects are left out) | s | both start and end are recorded | row not written (EPOCH_TIMES_MISSING); end before start: EPOCH_STOP_BEFORE_START. BrainSTEM has no trial records, so no trials table is written |

## Extension

| Rule | NWB destination | Sources | Transformation | Units | Condition | When missing |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `extension.brainstem` | ndx-brainstem: /general/brainstem (BrainstemMetadata with BrainstemTables) | — | every included BrainSTEM record as a row of the table for its kind; every field as a column (strings as stored, other values as JSON); links as ragged DynamicTableRegions between tables and to /intervals/epochs; details_schema and coordinates_schema name the BrainSTEM JSON schemas, listed with their stable URLs (and embedded with --embed-schemas) in the schemas table | — | --extension brainstem | administrative lab resources (licenses, data storages, inventories) and record bookkeeping are left out; records after the session start are left out as in the core file |
| `extension.localization` | ndx-anatomical-localization: /general/localization (AnatomicalCoordinatesTable per space) | `modules.procedure.coordinates`<br>`modules.procedure.coordinates_json`<br>`modules.experimentalinterface.coordinates`<br>`modules.experimentalinterface.coordinates_json` | Stereotaxic_BregmaAbsolute and Stereotaxic_LambdaAbsolute: x = ML, y = AP, z = DV in mm (orientation RAI, origin bregma or lambda); CCF_XYZ_Absolute: x, y, z in the Allen CCFv3 space (PIR, um). localized_entity = the record's row in the ndx-brainstem table; brain_region = target region acronyms; method names the coordinate system | mm (stereotaxic), um (CCF) | --extension brainstem; coordinates in one of these systems with all three axes | brain-surface systems and other spaces: LOCALIZATION_NOT_SUPPORTED; a missing axis or unit: LOCALIZATION_INCOMPLETE |
